description: Link a pull profile to an application version, so its new deployments get the bucket files at boot, or unlink it (unlink: true). Running deployments are not changed.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

name: edgegap_link_pull_profile
title: Link or unlink a pull profile and a version
